title:
V4.7 Card Collection Weapon 🔥
You can collect up to 150 cards in the 4.6 update. After collecting them, you will get a free JS9 skin.
For more details, read the official text below:
Collect 150 different cards to directly obtain the first upgradable JS9 (total 5 levels) when Version 4.7 starts.
Each different special card obtained grants an extra 10-card bonus.
Unfinished progress in the current version will be carried forward to the next version.
The event will end at the end of December 2026. Please refer to the official follow-up announcement for the exact deadline.
v4.6 PUBGM & BGMI x ONE-PUNCH-MAN - Release Date: 2026-09-20
v4.6 PUBGM & BGMI x B.DUCK - Release Date: 2026-10-02
